title: Direct compact-support input reductions agree with the completed integral tower
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme W, with the completed integral coefficient sheaf and finite coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let K be any object of the unbounded derived category of modules on the small pro-etale site of W [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For natural indices m >= n (representing positive exponents m+1 and n+1), let rho be the canonical direct quotient reduction compactSupportReductionMap and let the canonical restriction compositor be compactSupportRestrictionComp [def-coef-compact-support-reduction-maps]. Then restricting rho along the completed coefficient projection and following by this compositor is exactly the arrow from level m to level n of the specified integral reduction tower sfIntegralReductionTower [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. This asserts equality of the actual morphisms and requires no boundedness, constructibility, or finite-type assumption.

proof.text: Take the native derived reduction system and its finite evaluation isomorphisms from [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The private compactSupportReductionTransition theorem in the existing reduction-map module identifies its finite quotient transition, after the evaluation isomorphisms, with compactSupportReductionMap of [def-coef-compact-support-reduction-maps]. This is the scalar-adjunction calculation: both maps transpose to the smaller reduction unit.

proof.text: Apply compactSupportCoefficientTransition_restricted of [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition] and naturality of the completed restriction compositor. The resulting evaluation isomorphisms transport every native completed transition to the direct restricted compactSupportReductionMap. The native maps form a functor on the opposite natural numbers: their identity and composition equations follow from Localization.liftNatTrans_id and Localization.comp_liftNatTrans.

proof.text: Compare ordinary restriction compositors using compactSupportModuleRes_eq of [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition] and coefficientRestrictionComp of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The direct quotient compositor is identity on all underlying sections, so it equals the equality-induced isomorphism of restriction functors. The normalized limit-projection compositor has the same description. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_trans and Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_isoWhiskerRight transport their equality to exact derived restriction. Invariance of restricted adjoint mates under a change of the intermediate restriction functor follows by injectivity and naturality of the adjunction Hom bijection.

The preceding compositor comparison and mate calculation therefore identify the direct restricted reduction with that adjacent transition.

proof.text: Use NatTrans.ofOpSequence with the evaluation isomorphisms and the adjacent comparison to construct a natural transformation from the native completed tower to sfIntegralReductionTower [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Its naturality equation at an arbitrary comparable pair, combined with the transported native transition equation, gives the claimed equality after cancelling the invertible evaluation at the larger index. Identities and all nonadjacent pairs are included by functoriality.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportInput_completed_tower (W : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W)) :
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E W m).map
          (compactSupportReductionMap l E W m n h K) ≫
        (compactSupportRestrictionComp l E W m n h).hom.app
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E W n).obj K) =
        (sfIntegralReductionTower l E W K).map (homOfLE h).op
